query:
SELECT
            (date_trunc('day', bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))::date AS "day!",
            SUM(up_count)::bigint     AS "up_count!",
            SUM(sample_count)::bigint AS "sample_count!"
        FROM heartbeat_rollups
        WHERE monitor_id = $1
          AND bucket_start >= $2
          AND bucket_start <  $3
        GROUP BY 1
        ORDER BY 1 ASC
